services.name: Sunset & Harbor Cruise
services.desc: What better way is there to experience the beauty that the city by the sea has to offer than a harbor cruise? Sit back, relax and sip on a cocktail while we listen to music and explore Newport harbor. On these harbor cruises we’ll do two perimeter runs of the harbor then shoot out into the bay to see iconic views like Castle Hill lighthouse, Clingstone ‘house on the rocks’, Fort Adams and the Naval War College. Expect to see dozens of yachts, Americas Cup racing boats, classic wooden boats and whatever else the harbor has to offer that day!
